Order on Criminal Misc. Withdrawal Application
1.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that he does not want to press the withdrawal
application.
2. Accordingly, the application is dismissed as not pressed.

Order on Appeal
1.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.G.A. for the State respondent.

2. The accused-appellant has been convicted and sentenced by judgment and order dated 7.10.2023,
passed by learned Juvenile Board/Special Judge POCSO Act, Budaun, in Sessions Case No.2071 of 2023 (State of U.P. vs. X-Juvenile) arising out of Case Crime No. 378 of 2023, under Section 363,
366-A, 376(3) IPC and Section 5L/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
P.S. Bisauli, District Budaun.

sentences.text: 3. Allegation in the FIR is that the daughter of the informant, aged about 13 years, was enticed away by the appellant on 2.7.2023.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the age of the appellant was 16 years at the time of the occurrence.
Though the age of the victim has been mentioned to be 13 years at the time of occurrence but when her ossification test was conducted, she was found to be 19 years of age.
Moreover, she has made a statement before the Magistrate that she herself had gone with the appellant.
5. Learned AGA has opposed this fact that the appellant was a juvenile at the time of occurrence.

6. Let the accused-appellant namely 'X' Juvenile convicted and sentenced in the above mentioned case be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond of his father, namely, Vijay Pal @ Sopali, who is his natural guardian with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
On acceptance of bail bond and personal bond, the lower court shall transmit photostat copies thereof to this Court for being kept on the record.
7. The appeal is disposed of.

(Anil Kumar-X,J.) September 4, 2025 Ujjawal  X- Juvenile vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70660003/
